item.title: [−2] Silver Falls Below $50: Hawkish Fed Bets, Rising Yields And Dollar Trigger Fresh Selloff
item.description:
Signal: lower metal prices. 3 reports from FXEmpire, TradingView, Investing.com India. Related: “Silver Falls As A Stronger Dollar And Rising Treasury Yields Fuel Fed Hike Bets By Kedia Advisory”. Turn: earlier readings (12 Nov) pointed the other way.

Metals, cement & chemicals: headwind (−2) — Lower realisations for producers

Why it matters: Falling metal prices cut Indian producers' realisations, often on weak Chinese demand, while easing input costs for manufacturers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US-Israel-Iran War Latest News: Energy Tanker Reportedly Attacked Near Strait of Hormuz, Raising Concerns Over Security of Global Oil Route
item.description:
Signal: shipping chokepoint disruption. 21 reports from Mathrubhumi English, The Hawk, India.com and 16 more. Related: “Three ships struck by drones in Black Sea near Romanian shipping canal, PM says”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 9 Nov).

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Crude-linked inputs costlier

Why it matters: India imports most of its crude and much of its LNG through Hormuz and the Red Sea; disruption lifts oil, freight and insurance costs, widening the import bill and pressuring the rupee.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Iran says supertanker carrying 2 million barrels of oil sinks after 2 ships hit mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Signal: lower oil prices. 4 reports from The Times of India, NDTV, India Shipping News. Related: “Oil prices fall as surplus fears return after a nine-month dry spell in the market”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 9 Nov).

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild tailwind (+1) — Petrochemical inputs cheaper

Why it matters: Cheaper crude shrinks India's import bill, supports the rupee, eases inflation and lifts margins for fuel marketers, airlines and crude-linked manufacturers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +2, Inflation outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
